My friends who don't have little siblings think he's so cute and always hype him up and stuff. Last night my mom left me in charge because she wasn't going to be home until like 1am, and she said it was fine if I had my one friend over because she trusts him. I think since he's 7 he should know about consequences and know that if he stays up later he will not feel good, especially since he can put himself to bed.
